_comment: Illustrative defaults, not survey-calibrated. gain_w_per_m2 (9 W/m^2) approximates ASHRAE 90.1 Table 9.5.1 office lighting power density (0.79 W/ft^2 ~ 8.5 W/m^2), rounded; no separate equipment-load figure added since office plug loads are already broadly covered by the per-occupant heat_gain_active_kw split. Blended with (not replacing) the per-occupant gains -- see core/buem_adapter.py to_buem_profiles().
